Replace.Text: 所有城市可获得的来自建筑延伸至周围城市的 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力加成没有次数限制。
The regional bonus [ICON_Production] Production from buildings has no limit toward all cities.
所有城市可获得的来自建筑延伸至周围城市的 [ICON_Science] 科技值加成没有次数限制。
The regional bonus [ICON_Science] Science from buildings has no limit toward all cities.
所有城市可获得的来自建筑延伸至周围城市的 [ICON_Culture] 文化值加成没有次数限制。
The regional bonus [ICON_Culture] Culture from buildings has no limit toward all cities.
所有改良后的战略资源每回合额外产出2点。所有战斗单位+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。若单位拥有远程攻击能力，则+1射程。工业区区域的 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力相邻加成也能提供 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

All improved Strategic resources yield 2 additional resource per turn. All combat units receive +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and if the unit has a range attack +1 Range. Industrial zone district's [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production adjacency bonus provides [ICON_GOLD] Gold as well.
进行太空竞赛项目时+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。拥有宇航中心或航空港的城市+15% [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和 [ICON_PRODUCTION] 生产力。学院区域提供等于其 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值加成的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

+50% [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production towards Space race projects. +15% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production to Cities with either a Spaceport or Aerodrome. Campus districts provide [ICON_GOLD] Gold equal to their [ICON_SCIENCE] Science bonus.
每拥有1座奇观，则+4 [ICON_CULTURE] 文化值。城市中的每座奇观使9单元格内的外国城市每回合损失2点忠诚度。剧院广场区域提供等于其 [ICON_Culture] 文化值加成的 [ICON_GOLD] 金币。

+4 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture for every Wonder. Each Wonder in your cities cause foreign cities within 9 tiles to lose 2 Loyalty per turn. Theater districts provide [ICON_GOLD] Gold equal to their [ICON_Culture] Culture bonus.
所有战斗单位+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。受伤单位每回合回复的生命值+10。
All combat units receive +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. Wounded units can heal +10 HP per turn.
罗马禁卫军：+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
Praetorian Guard: +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength.
所有单位获得的经验值+50%；生产军事单位时+25% [ICON_Production] 生产力。
+50% XP earned for all units and +25% [ICON_Production] Production towards military units.
所有建造者+2 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。可以用 [ICON_Faith] 信仰值购买平民单位。
+2 [ICON_Movement] Movement for all Builders. May purchase civilian units with [ICON_Faith] Faith.
所有国家公园提供的 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩+100%；世界奇观提供的 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩+100%。
+100% [ICON_Tourism] Tourism from World Wonders. +100% [ICON_Tourism] Tourism to all National Parks.
[ICON_CAPITAL] 首都所有类型产出+75%。[NEWLINE]减益：所有 [ICON_Governor] 总督都会遭到陷害，且无法调职。
+75% for all types of yields in your [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital. BUT: All [ICON_Governor] Governors are neutralized and cannot be reestablished.
间谍部署到另一文明的城市无需时间。完成攻击性任务的时间缩短25%。信息和未来时代的单位+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE]减益：对您的 [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] 不满不会下降。

Spies take no time to establish their presence in another civilization's city. Time to complete all offensive missions reduced by 25%. +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength against units from the Information and Future Eras.[NEWLINE]BUT: [ICON_STAT_GRIEVANCE] Grievances against you do not decay.
国内贸易路线提供+3所有类型产出。[NEWLINE]减益：无法生产或购买开拓者，也无法建立新城市。
Domestic routes provide +3 for all types of yields.[NEWLINE]BUT: Can't train or buy Settlers nor settle new cities.
农场+1 [ICON_Food] 食物+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。+100%工业区 [ICON_Production] 生产力相邻加成。工业区提供等同于其相邻加成的 [ICON_FOOD] 食物。[NEWLINE]减益：伟人点数的获取速度减缓50%。

Farms provide +1 [ICON_Food] Food and +1 [ICON_Production] Production. Industrial Zones provide +100% [ICON_Production] Production adjacency bonus. Industrial Zones provide [ICON_FOOD] Food equal to their adjacency bonus.[NEWLINE]BUT: [ICON_GreatPerson] Great People Points earned 50% slower.
有 [ICON_Governor] 总督就职的城市+10%所有类型产出。[NEWLINE]减益：没有就职 [ICON_Governor] 总督的城市-10%所有类型产出。
+10% for all types of yields in cities with [ICON_Governor] Governors. BUT: -10% for all types of yields in all cities without an established [ICON_Governor] Governor.
每拥有1个广播中心，每回合便获得+8 [ICON_Favor] 外交支持。在您的领土内的敌方间谍等级降低3级。[NEWLINE]减益：所有城市中的 [ICON_SCIENCE] 科技值和 [ICON_Culture] 文化值-5%。
+8 [ICON_Favor] Diplomatic Favor per turn for each Broadcast Center. Enemy Spy level reduced by 3 in your lands.[NEWLINE]BUT: -5% [ICON_SCIENCE] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture in all cities.
拥有10点或更少 [ICON_CITIZEN] 人口的城市+40%所有类型产出。[NEWLINE]减益：[ICON_CITIZEN] 人口超过10点的城市-10%所有类型产出。
Cities with 10 or less [ICON_CITIZEN] population receive +40% for all types of yields. BUT: Cities with more than 10 [ICON_CITIZEN] population receive -10% for all types of yields.
核计划项目和核装置的 [ICON_Production] 生产力+100%。核装置无需维护费。[NEWLINE]但无法通过影响力获得新的 [ICON_Envoy] 使者。
+100% [ICON_Production] Production to nuclear program projects and Nuclear Devices. No maintenance fee for WMD.[NEWLINE]BUT: Earn no influence toward new [ICON_Envoy] Envoys.
进行城市项目时，您城市的 [ICON_Production] 生产力+100%。[NEWLINE]减益：城市每回合-1 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。
Your cities get +100% [ICON_Production] Production towards city projects.[NEWLINE]BUT: -1 [ICON_Amenities] Amenity per turn in your cities.
所有战斗单位+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。所有单位的战斗经验值+100%。[NEWLINE]减益：每个战斗和间谍单位的维护费用+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币。
All combat units receive +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength. +100% combat experience for all units.[NEWLINE]BUT: +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold to maintain each combat and spy unit.
精兵政策：+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
Elite Forces: +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength.
在当前未交战的文明中举办音乐会获得的 [ICON_TOURISM] 旅游业绩+100%。您的摇滚乐队可以选择任何可用升级。[NEWLINE]减益：生产摇滚乐队之外的所有单位时生产力-50%、购买时则费用+50%。

All Civilizations not currently at war receive +100% of the [ICON_TOURISM] Tourism from your Concerts. Your Rock Band units can choose from any possible promotion.[NEWLINE]BUT: The cost of producing is decreased by 50% and purchasing is +50% for units other than Rock Bands.
进攻城市和区域时+20 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。[NEWLINE]减益：与单位作战时-5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
+20 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength vs. city attacks and district defenses. BUT: -5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength against units.
拥有圣地的城市+20% [ICON_Science] 科技值和 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。[NEWLINE]减益：但没有圣地的城市的-20% [ICON_Science] 科技值和 [ICON_Culture] 文化值。
+20% [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture in cities with a Holy Site.[NEWLINE]BUT: -20% [ICON_Science] Science and [ICON_Culture] Culture in cities without a Holy Site.
拥有银行或造船厂的城市+15% [ICON_Gold] 金币和 [ICON_Production] 生产力。拥有码头或证券交易所的城市再+15% [ICON_Gold] 金币和 [ICON_Production] 生产力。[NEWLINE]减益：所有城市-2 [ICON_Amenities] 宜居度。

+15% [ICON_Gold] Gold and [ICON_Production] Production in cities with a Bank or a Shipyard. +15% [ICON_Gold] Gold and [ICON_Production] Production in cities with a Seaport or a Stock Exchange.[NEWLINE]BUT: -2 [ICON_Amenities] Amenities in all cities.
有宗教信仰的城市+40% [ICON_Faith] 信仰值。消耗1次使徒使用次数开始宗教审讯。友方领土中的所有宗教单位+15 [ICON_Religion] 宗教战斗力。[NEWLINE]减益：所有城市的 [ICON_Science] 科技值-10%。

+40% [ICON_Faith] for cities with a religion. Start Inquisition with 1 Apostle charge. All Religious units +15 [ICON_Religion] Religious Combat Strength in friendly territory.[NEWLINE]BUT: -10% [ICON_Science] Science in all cities.
